map.井字棋适合哪些场景？: What scenarios is Tic-Tac-Toe best for?
map.井字棋是一款娱乐游戏领域的在线工具。娱乐游戏工具，纯前端实现，无需安装，离线可玩: Tic-Tac-Toe is an online tool in the entertainment & games category. A casual game tool—pure frontend, no install, playable offline.
map.X 先手，双方轮流在格子中放置自己的标记: X moves first; players take turns placing their mark in a cell
map.率先将三个标记连成一线者获胜（横、竖、斜均可）: First to line up three marks wins (horizontal, vertical, or diagonal)
map.如果所有格子填满仍无人获胜，则为平局: If all cells fill with no winner, it is a draw
map.：使用 Minimax 算法，完美玩家，最多平局: : uses Minimax, a perfect player, at best a draw
map.注意防守对手的潜在连线: Watch and block the opponent potential line
map.制造\"双活三\"局面让对手无法防守: Create a double-threat so the opponent cannot defend
map.休闲对弈打发时间: Casual play to pass the time
map.3×3 棋盘轮流落子，先连成一线（横/竖/斜）者胜；满盘无连线判平局。人机模式常: On a 3x3 board players alternate; first to a line (horizontal/vertical/diagonal) wins; a full board with no line is a draw. The AI mode commonly uses Minimax to search the best move.
map.你执 X 占中心(1,1)，电脑执 O 占角(0,0)；你再占(2,2)形成对角: You play X and take center (1,1); the computer plays O in corner (0,0); you then take (2,2) to form a diagonal threat, forcing the computer to block at (0,2) or (2,0), else you complete the diagonal next. At most 9 moves decide win or draw.
map.先手有必胜策略吗？: Does the first player have a winning strategy?
map.双方都最优时必平局；先手占中心可最大化不败概率，但无法保证必胜。: With both optimal it is always a draw; first player taking center maximizes the no-loss chance but cannot guarantee a win.
map.电脑难度怎么调？: How do I adjust AI difficulty?
map.可切换随机/启发式/Minimax 全搜索；难度越高越难被击败，纯前端即可运行。: Switch between random / heuristic / full Minimax search; the higher the difficulty the harder to beat, runs purely in the frontend.
